Why Gigamon?

Hybrid cloud environments are becoming increasingly complex as AI drives a surge in data volumes, traffic, and infrastructure demands. The Gigamon Deep Observability Pipeline delivers optimized traffic, enriched metadata, and trusted network-derived telemetry that help eliminate blind spots, improve tool effectiveness, strengthen security, and validate compliance.

Eliminate Security Blind Spots

Learn how Gigamon can help you eliminate blind spots across hybrid cloud infrastructure by delivering network-derived intelligence to your security and observability tools. Gain deep observability into lateral traffic to detect previously hidden threats and strengthen your security posture.

Illuminate East-West Traffic LEARN MORE

Optimize Network Traffic

Learn how Gigamon can help you make existing network traffic tools up to 90 percent more efficient by eliminating duplicate and irrelevant traffic, filtering out low-risk traffic, and centralizing deduplication and decryption — without compromising data fidelity and security.

Gigamon optimizes traffic to tools LEARN MORE

Reduce Tool Costs

Learn how Gigamon can help you to optimize and improve signal-to-noise ratio of network traffic ingestion to realize a potential 50-60 percent savings on your tools spend along with deferrals of in-year new capacity purchases.

Certified as a Great Place to Work, we offer a deep observability pipeline that efficiently delivers network-derived intelligence to cloud, security, and observability tools. This helps our customers to eliminate security blind spots, optimize network traffic, and dramatically reduce tool cost and complexity, enabling them to better secure and manage their hybrid cloud infrastructure. Gigamon has served more than 4,000 customers worldwide, including over 80 percent of Fortune 100 enterprises, 9 of the 10 largest mobile network providers, and hundreds of governments and educational organizations.</p><p>The Senior Tax Analyst will join Gigamon’s global tax function and support U.S. federal, state and local, and international tax activities. Based in Chennai, this role will partner closely with the Director, Accounting Operations, the Senior Director of Tax, Accounting teams in the U.S. and India, external tax advisors, tax authorities, and business stakeholders. The position will contribute to accurate and timely tax compliance, tax accounting, reconciliations, audits, notices, and related projects. Success in this role requires strong technical knowledge, careful attention to detail, and effective collaboration across U.S. and India time zones.</p><h3>What you’ll do:</h3><ul><li><p>Prepare, review, and support state and local sales, use, commercial activity, and other indirect tax returns.</p></li><li><p>Prepare monthly and quarterly sales and use tax accruals and support related account reconciliations.</p></li><li><p>Maintain taxability and product-mapping data in sales tax systems, including Avalara AvaTax.</p></li><li><p>Prepare and submit responses to federal, state, and local tax notices in coordination with internal stakeholders and external advisors.</p></li><li><p>Support tax audits by gathering documentation, preparing schedules, and tracking open items through resolution.</p></li><li><p>Assist with U.S. federal, state, and international income tax compliance, including preparation of supporting workpapers and responses to information requests.</p></li><li><p>Support the annual income tax provision process under ASC 740 by gathering data, preparing provision schedules and journal entries, reconciling tax accounts, and maintaining documentation.</p></li><li><p>Assist with estimated tax payment analysis and review tax-related general ledger activity.</p></li><li><p>Maintain organized, accurate, and review-ready tax workpapers and supporting documentation.</p></li><li><p>Contribute to accounting and other tax-related special projects as needed.</p></li></ul><h3>What you’ve done:</h3><ul><li><p>Earned a Chartered Accountant qualification or are a semi-qualified Chartered Accountant with a bachelor’s degree in accounting.</p></li><li><p>Gained approximately 3–6 years of progressive accounting and tax experience, including meaningful corporate tax experience.</p></li><li><p>Developed experience with U.S. sales and use tax, income tax compliance, tax accounting, or a comparable combination of tax disciplines.</p></li><li><p>Demonstrated strong Microsoft Excel skills, including experience working with large data sets, reconciliations, lookups, pivot tables, and supporting schedules.</p></li><li><p>Worked with an enterprise resource planning or general ledger system; experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 is preferred.</p></li><li><p>Supported tax compliance, provision, audit, notice-response, or reconciliation activities in a corporate, public accounting, or comparable environment.</p></li></ul><h3>Who you are:</h3><ul><li><p>A detail-oriented professional who takes ownership of work and maintains high standards for accuracy.</p></li><li><p>An organized and dependable collaborator who can manage recurring deadlines and multiple priorities.</p></li><li><p>A clear written and verbal communicator who can explain tax matters to finance and non-tax stakeholders.</p></li><li><p>A sound decision-maker who uses good judgment when reviewing data, resolving issues, and escalating risks.</p></li><li><p>An adaptable team member who works effectively with colleagues, advisors, and business partners across functions and geographies.</p></li><li><p>Willing and able to work during overlapping U.S. and India business hours when required.</p></li><li><p>Comfortable working in a full-time hybrid arrangement, with three days per week in the Chennai office.</p></li></ul>
            </p>

                <div>At Gigamon, our purpose is to protect the hybrid networks and data of the largest, most complex organizations on the planet. Gigamon has served more than 4,000 customers worldwide, including over 80 percent of Fortune 100 enterprises, 9 of the 10 largest mobile network providers, and hundreds of governments and educational organizations.</div><div> </div><div>The Customer Success Engineer (CSE) is a highly technical, customer-facing role within our Customer Success organization that bridges technical credibility with strategic customer engagement.             <p ng-non-bindable>
                <p>At Gigamon, our purpose is to protect the hybrid networks and data of the largest, most complex organizations on the planet. Certified as a Great Place to Work, we offer a deep observability pipeline that efficiently delivers network-derived intelligence to cloud, security, and observability tools. This helps our customers to eliminate security blind spots, optimize network traffic, and dramatically reduce tool cost and complexity, enabling them to better secure and manage their hybrid cloud infrastructure. Gigamon has served more than 4,000 customers worldwide, including over 80 percent of Fortune 100 enterprises, 9 of the 10 largest mobile network providers, and hundreds of governments and educational organizations.   </p><p> </p><p>We are seeking a Technical Support Engineer to provide world-class support to Gigamon customers and partners. This role requires a friendly, polished communicator committed to solving complex problems and delivering high-level customer satisfaction. You will get the opportunity to work with Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success to resolve Gigamon products issues. The position also requires you to analyze and report on customer satisfaction with products, services, and processes, for ongoing improvement of customer experience. You won’t be in this alone. We are a team that helps each other and likes to have fun too.   </p><p> </p><p><span style="font-size: 14.0pt;"><strong>What you’ll do:    </strong></span></p><ul><li>Deliver a top-tier user support experience using SalesForce service cloud software.   </li><li>Interact with our customers/ partners using our case management system, phone, email, and/or shared screen sessions. </li><li>Be the customer’s contact for providing accurate and creative technical solutions to user-reported problems. </li><li>Update and document the details of the issues, and the steps taken to solve them, follow-up conversations, escalations, and resolution in our case management system. </li><li>Create and add to knowledge base articles in our knowledge base. </li><li>Apply advanced troubleshooting techniques (debug and diagnosis) on critical problems that may span multiple products and features, including the ability to isolate, replicate and create workarounds to achieve high levels of customer satisfaction. </li><li>Report defects to Engineering after lab replications, meeting the Escalation standards. </li><li>Work collaboratively within the Support organization in driving Support process improvements and initiatives. </li><li>Participate in periodic weekend shifts and rotational 24*7 on-call support to provide escalation coverage to Elite customers outside of regular work hours. </li><li>Manage customer escalations and drive issues to completion while keeping involved parties in the loop. </li><li>Work with other organizations to convey customer concerns and requirements.    </li></ul><p> </p><p><span style="font-size: 14.0pt;"><strong>What you’ve done:  </strong></span>  </p><ul><li>Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Technology, related technical discipline, or equal professional technical experience. </li><li>Targeting candidates with ~0-2 Years of Technical support experience in either networking or security </li><li>Hands on experience with L2 and L3 technologies including Ethernet, TCP/IP, Routing Protocols, switching technologies, Stacking, QoS   </li></ul><p> </p><p><span style="font-size: 14.0pt;"><strong>Who you are:    </strong></span></p><ul><li>Advanced or Fluent in English and Spanish (verbal and written) </li><li>Solid knowledge of TCP/IP and OSI networking model </li><li>Excellent problem solving and             </p>

            <h3>Description</h3>
            <p ng-non-bindable>
                <div><span style="font-family: sans-serif , arial , helvetica;font-size: 11.0pt;">At Gigamon, our purpose is to protect the hybrid networks and data of the largest, most complex organizations on the planet. Certified as a Great Place to Work, we offer a deep observability pipeline that efficiently delivers network-derived intelligence to cloud, security, and observability tools. This helps our customers to eliminate security blind spots, optimize network traffic, and dramatically reduce tool cost and complexity, enabling them to better secure and manage their hybrid cloud infrastructure. Gigamon has served more than 4,000 customers worldwide, including over 80 percent of Fortune 100 enterprises, 9 of the 10 largest mobile network providers, and hundreds of governments and educational organizations.</span></div><div><span style="font-family: sans-serif , arial , helvetica;font-size: 11.0pt;"> </span></div><div><span style="font-family: sans-serif , arial , helvetica;font-size: 11.0pt;"> </span></div><div><span style="font-family: sans-serif , arial , helvetica;font-size: 11.0pt;">As a Sr. Staff Hardware Engineer, you will drive the design and development of next-generation hardware platforms that enable traffic aggregation and deep network observability. You will work as part of a small, highly collaborative global team, owning board-level design, bring-up, and validation while coordinating closely with JDM/ODM/OEM partners. In this role, you will define system architectures, qualify critical optical components, and support both new product introduction and sustaining activities. Your work will have a direct impact on the performance, reliability, and scalability of Gigamon’s hardware portfolio.</span></div><div><span style="font-family: sans-serif , arial , helvetica;font-size: 11.0pt;"> </span></div><div><span style="font-family: sans-serif , arial , helvetica;font-size: 11.0pt;"> </span></div><div><span style="font-family: sans-serif , arial ,             <h3>Description</h3>
            <p ng-non-bindable>
                <p>At Gigamon, our purpose is to protect the hybrid networks and data of the largest, most complex organizations on the planet. Certified as a Great Place to Work, we offer a deep observability pipeline that efficiently delivers network-derived intelligence to cloud, security, and observability tools. This helps our customers to eliminate security blind spots, optimize network traffic, and dramatically reduce tool cost and complexity, enabling them to better secure and manage their hybrid cloud infrastructure. Gigamon has served more than 4,000 customers worldwide, including over 80 percent of Fortune 100 enterprises, 9 of the 10 largest mobile network providers, and hundreds of governments and educational organizations.</p><p>The Field & Channel Marketing Manager will join Gigamon’s Sales and Marketing team in India, supporting revenue growth, qualified pipeline generation, and partner engagement across the country. Based in Mumbai, this role will develop and execute integrated field and channel marketing programs in collaboration with India sales and channel leaders, regional marketing teams, partners, distributors, agencies, and cross-functional stakeholders. The manager will oversee programs from planning through execution, follow-up, and performance reporting, while managing budgets and ensuring alignment with APAC and global marketing priorities. This role reports to the VP, Global Field & Channel Marketing and requires occasional travel within India.</p><h3>What you’ll do:</h3><ul><li><p>Translate India sales and channel priorities into integrated field and channel marketing strategies and annual or quarterly plans.</p></li><li><p>Own the end-to-end execution of approved marketing programs, including stakeholder alignment, planning, delivery, follow-up, and performance reporting.</p></li><li><p>Partner with India sales and channel leaders to design programs that generate qualified pipeline and contribute to revenue through direct and partner-led activities.</p></li><li><p>Collaborate with channel account managers, distributors, resellers, and technology partners to develop and execute demand-generation and channel-enablement programs.</p></li><li><p>Plan and manage B2B industry events, executive engagements, campaigns, webinars, and other customer- and partner-facing activities.</p></li><li><p>Coordinate agencies, timelines, logistics, communications, and success measures for marketing programs.</p></li><li><p>Develop and execute integrated campaigns across digital, events, partner marketing, communications, and enablement channels.</p></li><li><p>Manage allocated marketing investments and program budgets, including forecasting, spend management, budget reconciliation, compliance, purchase orders, invoices, expenses, and program documentation.</p></li><li><p>Track program performance using agreed metrics, marketing automation platforms, and CRM systems; provide timely insights and recommendations to India and APAC sales and marketing leadership.</p></li><li><p>Use performance data and stakeholder feedback to optimize future programs, improve pipeline contribution, and strengthen partner engagement.</p></li><li><p>Support APAC-wide programs and campaigns in India as required.</p></li></ul><h3>What you’ve done:</h3><ul><li><p>Earned a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.</p></li><li><p>Built 6–10 years of experience in field marketing, channel marketing, or integrated B2B technology marketing.</p></li><li><p>Planned and executed B2B industry events and partner-led demand-generation programs from the ground up, delivering against defined goals and budgets.</p></li><li><p>Developed strong relationships with distributors, resellers, value-added distributors, and technology partners within the India market.</p></li><li><p>Managed agencies, vendors, timelines, logistics, communications, and other executional requirements for marketing programs.</p></li><li><p>Executed digital marketing programs directly or through partners to increase awareness, engagement, lead generation, and pipeline across India.</p></li><li><p>Translated sales and marketing objectives into clear strategies, actionable tactics, measurable success criteria, and execution plans.</p></li><li><p>Monitored and evaluated marketing programs, events, and campaigns using marketing automation and CRM systems.</p></li><li><p>Demonstrated proficiency with marketing automation and CRM platforms such as Marketo and Salesforce.</p></li><li><p>Familiarity with Folloze, Workfront, Monday.com, and 6sense is an advantage, along with the ability to learn new systems quickly.</p></li><li><p>Gained experience marketing network security, cybersecurity, observability, or related technology solutions.</p></li><li><p>Developed knowledge of the India technology partner and channel ecosystem.</p></li><li><p>Worked effectively in a global organization and collaborated with regional and worldwide marketing teams.</p></li></ul><h3>Who you are:</h3><ul><li><p>A results-oriented marketer who connects field and channel programs to measurable pipeline, revenue, and partner outcomes.</p></li><li><p>A strategic and practical thinker who can translate business priorities into focused, executable marketing plans.</p></li><li><p>An organized project manager who can manage multiple priorities, stakeholders, agencies, and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.</p></li><li><p>An analytical professional who uses performance data and stakeholder feedback to improve program effectiveness.</p></li><li><p>A clear communicator and collaborative partner who can influence cross-functional stakeholders and work effectively with sales, channel, marketing, and external teams.</p></li><li><p>A self-directed contributor who leverages internal and external resources to deliver high-quality work on time and within budget.</p></li><li><p>Detail-oriented, particularly in budget management, marketing operations, and program administration.</p></li><li><p>Willing and able to travel within India as required.</p></li></ul>
            </p>
